name: BFME1 1.03 game.dat, SafeDisc-unpacked, crack patches reverted

unpack.author: withmorten
unpack.shared: by withmorten on the project Discord, 2026-09-27

provenance.method: The workshop image with every reverted_patches range restored to the unpack's bytes and the PE checksum recomputed. Everything else is the workshop image: withmorten's SafeDisc repairs, the workshop icon and the section layout.

reverted_patches.what: isLauncherRunning call swapped for Win32CDManager::createDrive (thunk 0x00433AD2); both launcher checks forced to pass
je->jmp: never sets the flag when the lotrb.sec string is not lotrsec.big
exe CRC loop replaced by hard-coded gamenoDRM.dat CRC 0x560A4FE9
